description: [WRITE] Create an X (Twitter) Conversion API SERVER tag from the Stape template (stape-io/twitter-tag), imported automatically. The template has NO event-name field: eventId is the per-conversion X "Event ID" (tw-…) from X Ads > Events Manager, so one tag = one X conversion event and the server trigger decides when it fires. Auth is EITHER pixelAccessToken OR the OAuth 1.0a quartet. conversionId is the dedup row against the X Pixel. containerId must be the SERVER container. Needs a SERVER trigger (triggers_create) passed as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

name.description: Tag name; defaults to "X CAPI Tag".

serverEventData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

userData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

name: create_x_capi_server_tag
